surface: Blocks gallery, Templates page and the Block specimens

sentences.en: Ship the interface, not the design review
sentences.zh: 交付界面，而不是设计评审

sentences.en: A section that states one claim, proves it in the subhead and offers exactly one next step.
sentences.zh: 一个只讲一个主张的区块：副标题给出证据，并且只给一个下一步。

sentences.en: Tokens first
sentences.zh: 先有令牌

sentences.en: Every value is a named role, in both themes.
sentences.zh: 两套主题下，每个取值都是一个有名有姓的角色。

sentences.en: Keyboard honest
sentences.zh: 键盘行为不打折

sentences.en: Focus, roving tabindex and announcements ship with the primitive.
sentences.zh: 焦点、轮转 tabindex 与朗读提示都随基础组件一起交付。

sentences.en: Server safe
sentences.zh: 服务端安全

sentences.en: No component reaches for the window during render.
sentences.zh: 渲染期间没有任何组件去碰 window。

sentences.en: Deploys this week
sentences.zh: 本周发版次数

sentences.en: Open incidents
sentences.zh: 未解决故障

sentences.en: Everything in this documentation.
sentences.zh: 这套文档里的全部内容。

sentences.en: Not built, not sold, not promised.
sentences.zh: 尚未构建、尚未售卖，也不做任何承诺。

sentences.en: Backend engineer, mostly databases
sentences.zh: 后端工程师，主要和数据库打交道

sentences.en: I work on query planning and storage layout, and I write about both.
sentences.zh: 我做查询规划与存储布局，也把这两件事写下来。

sentences.en: Query planning, storage layout, and the parts of a database nobody demos.
sentences.zh: 查询规划、存储布局，以及数据库里没人会在演示里展示的那些部分。

sentences.en: Compaction, replication and an unhealthy amount of benchmarking.
sentences.zh: 合并、复制，以及多到不太健康的基准测试。

sentences.en: Measuring compaction cost honestly
sentences.zh: 诚实地度量合并成本

sentences.en: A planner for small data
sentences.zh: 面向小数据量的查询规划器

sentences.en: Database Internals
sentences.zh: 《Database Internals》

sentences.en: Deploy finished
sentences.zh: 发版完成

sentences.en: Incident resolved
sentences.zh: 故障已解决

sentences.en: Elevated p95 on the read path
sentences.zh: 读路径 p95 升高

sentences.en: Review requested
sentences.zh: 收到评审请求

sentences.en: Compaction cost model
sentences.zh: 合并成本模型

sentences.en: Deployments
sentences.zh: 发版记录

sentences.en: A section header with one action, which is all most console pages need.
sentences.zh: 只带一个操作的分区标题——大多数控制台页面需要的也就这些。

sentences.en: Whole-page starters built from LUC UI components and Blocks: personal sites, a marketing page, a product console and a research workspace.
sentences.zh: 用 LUC UI 组件与区块搭起的整页起点：个人站点、营销页面、产品控制台与研究工作台。

sentences.en: Editorial hero, a timeline with a real open end, work that expands in place, and a print action.
sentences.zh: 编辑风格首屏、带真实开放终点的时间线、原地展开的作品，以及一个打印动作。

sentences.en: Publications with year, kind and topic facets derived from the entries — and no invented citation counts.
sentences.zh: 论文列表按年份、类型与主题生成筛选条件，全部由条目推导；绝不编造引用次数。

sentences.en: A gallery-led grid where the chosen project grows into a detail region.
sentences.zh: 以画廊为主的网格，被选中的作品会就地展开成详情区域。

sentences.en: Journal and garden
sentences.zh: 日志与数字花园

sentences.en: Notes in date order, a reading shelf grouped by status, and a /now block that carries its date.
sentences.zh: 按日期排列的笔记、按状态分组的书架，以及自带日期的 /now 区块。

sentences.en: Marketing page
sentences.zh: 营销页面

sentences.en: Hero, capability narrative, proof, pricing that follows the billing period, and a validating lead form.
sentences.zh: 首屏、能力叙事、可信度证明、随计费周期变化的定价，以及先校验再提交的线索表单。

sentences.en: Shell, toolbar, a table that is the product, a dialog that adds a row, and a settings sheet.
sentences.zh: 外壳、工具栏、作为产品本体的表格、真的会新增一行的对话框，以及设置抽屉。

sentences.en: An index with search and topic filters, a comfortable reading view and a share control.
sentences.zh: 带搜索与主题筛选的索引、舒适的阅读视图，以及分享控件。

sentences.en: Research workspace
sentences.zh: 研究工作台

sentences.en: The flagship composition: shell, resizable panes, a chart with an inspector, a table, URL state and toasts.
sentences.zh: 旗舰级组合：外壳、可调整的分栏、带检查面板的图表、表格、URL 状态与提示消息。

sentences.en: No download
sentences.zh: 不提供下载

sentences.en: There is no archive to download, and this page will not offer one until a packaged starter contains every file, token and asset it needs — a download that does not build is worse than no download.
sentences.zh: 这里没有可下载的压缩包，在打包好的启动模板包含全部所需文件、令牌与资源之前，本页也不会提供下载——一个构建不起来的下载比没有下载更糟。

sentences.en: Reference pages
sentences.zh: 参考页面

sentences.en: Every entry below is a working route. What a reader supplies is stated, because a template that hides its data contract is a template nobody can use.
sentences.zh: 下面每一条都是可运行的路由。需要读者自己提供的部分都写明了——隐藏数据契约的模板，没有人能用起来。

sentences.en: Open the page
sentences.zh: 打开页面

sentences.en: Copying a template
sentences.zh: 如何复制一个模板

sentences.en: The honest workflow today: read the page, take the composition, bring your own data.
sentences.zh: 今天真正可行的流程：读页面、取组合方式、换上你自己的数据。

sentences.en: 1. Open the reference page and copy the composition you want — the structure is plain JSX over public exports.
sentences.zh: 1. 打开参考页面，复制你需要的组合方式——结构就是基于公开导出的普通 JSX。

sentences.en: 2. Replace the local fixtures with your data. Every template keeps its data in a small module beside the page, which is what makes that a mechanical edit.
sentences.zh: 2. 把本地固定数据换成你自己的数据。每个模板都把数据放在页面旁边的一个小模块里，所以这只是一次机械替换。

sentences.en: 3. Install the library and import the styles once at your app root — see the installation page for the commands that work today.
sentences.zh: 3. 安装这个库，并在应用根部引入一次样式——今天可用的命令见安装页面。

sentences.en: Blocks
sentences.zh: 区块

sentences.en: Build with it
sentences.zh: 用它来搭

sentences.en: You supply
sentences.zh: 你需要提供

sentences.en: Reusable page sections assembled from LUC UI components — a hero, a pricing band, a career timeline, a metrics strip.
sentences.zh: 用 LUC UI 组件拼出的可复用页面区块：首屏、定价带、职业时间线、指标条。

sentences.en: Filter
sentences.zh: 筛选

sentences.en: Blocks are grouped by the kind of page they belong to: marketing, personal, product.
sentences.zh: 区块按所属页面类型分组：营销、个人、产品。

sentences.en: All
sentences.zh: 全部

sentences.en: Every Block in the gallery, in reading order.
sentences.zh: 画廊里的全部区块，按阅读顺序排列。
